チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center は、PUBG モバイルを始めとする様々な高品質ゲームを手掛けた Lightspeed Studios の研究開発部門です。Tech Center は技術研究とイノベーションを牽引し、ゲーム作品にそのライフサイクルを通して、エンジン、音響、QA、AI、次世代技術、技術提携などのテクニカルサポートを提供しています。

Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

仕事内容

1. テンセントLighSpeedスタジオの次世代コンソールゲームプロジェクトにおいて、製品特性に適した音声デザインおよび実施プランを策定する。

2.音声デザインの計画に基づき、要件の調整、リソースの制作および統合、テスト検証と最適化を行い、ゲームの最終的なサウンド品質を管理する。

Job Description

1. Formulate sound design and implementation plans suitable for product features for Tencent LightSpeed Studio's next-generation console game projects.

2. Based on the sound design plan, coordinate requirements, create and integrate resources, conduct testing and optimization, and manage the final sound quality of the game.

応募資格/Who We Look For

応募資格

1.5年以上のゲーム音声制作経験があり、AAAクオリティの高品質ゲーム音声デザインにフルタイムで参加経験があること。ゲーム音声制作の全体フローに精通。

2.高いサウンドデザイン能力を持ち、音声録音、処理、ミキシングを効率よく行える。DAWソフト（Digital Audio Workstation）を1つ以上使いこなすことができ、エフェクターやシンセサイザーなどの音響設計ツールの実用的なスキルを有する。

3.サウンドデザインとパイプライン構築能力に優れ、Wwiseなどの音声ミドルウェアを使いこなせる。UnityやUEなどのゲームエンジンの基本操作に精通している。

4.日本語必須、英語か中国語でコミュニケーションできる方大歓迎。

5.プロジェクト管理スキルがあり、チーム内外で調整してニーズを期限内に確実に実行できる。

6.熱心なゲーマーで、ゲームとゲーム音声に対する情熱を持ち、ゲームプレイと音声デザインの関係について独自の理解がある。

Requirements

1. Over 5 years of experience in game sound production, with full-time participation in high-quality, AAA-standard game sound design, and a comprehensive understanding of the entire game sound production process.

2. Strong sound design skills, including efficient audio recording, processing, and mixing capabilities. Proficiency in using at least one DAW (Digital Audio Workstation) software and practical skills in sound design tools such as effects processors and synthesizers.

3. Excellent abilities in sound design and pipeline construction, with proficiency in audio middleware such as Wwise. Familiarity with basic operations of game engines such as Unity and Unreal Engine (UE).

4. Japanese fluency is required; candidates who can communicate in English or Chinese are highly welcomed.

5. Project management skills with the ability to coordinate within and outside the team to meet needs on time.

6. A passionate gamer with a deep interest in game sound and a unique understanding of the relationship between gameplay and sound design.

7. The ability to independently lead projects and work collaboratively as part of a team, with a focus on learning and teamwork.

Game Research Center(GRC) is a department focusing on game industry study, game analysis, game design research, data analysis and game development supporting. We’re one of the world’s leading research facility in game industry, building a global knowledge tank to help our teams make better decisions. We’re looking for innovative and passionate team members who love all kinds of games and have insight about the challenging global market.

This role sits within the GRC (Game Research Center) team. Its core mission is to bring in a highly authoritative game design leader with extensive hands-on development experience across global shooter, casual competitive and RPG game genres.

We are looking for a true genre expert who can help define the next generation of gameplay standards. 1. Gameplay and Systems Design

• Define and refine best-in-class minute-to-minute gameplay experience, including controls, movement, and player feedback across visual, audio, and haptic layers.

• Build scalable and deeply engaging gameplay systems, including combat systems, character control, level interaction, mission flow, progression systems, and long-term engagement loops.

•
Lead the design evaluation and strategic improvement of core gameplay pillars, including 3C, combat/system design, level design, mission structure, world interaction, and player progression.

Help identify genre opportunities, product risks, and improvement areas early through expert review, structured feedback, and design modeling.

Experience

• 10+ years of experience in game design. with at least the past 5 years spent as a lead designer or core systems owner on globally recognized large-scale game projects.

• Proven success in at least two of the following areas:

• Shooter games, with strong practical experience in level design, 3C, combat design, and/or gameplay systems design

• Casual competitive games, especially products involving creative sandbox, party royale, social-creative, or AI-enhanced gameplay experiences

• RPG games, with strong experience in narrative design, world-building, and/or quest design.

Deep understanding of gameplay loops such as combat, progression, mission structure, exploration, social interaction, player creativity, and long-term retention.

title: パブリッシングプロデューサー（スタジオ パブリッシング）｜Publishing Producer（Studio Publishing）
description:

市場 & パフォーマンス評価

リーダーシップ & メンタリング

• スタジオ、外部パートナー、Tencent チームと強く協働的な関係を構築する。

• パブリッシング担当者を指導し、スタジオおよび Tencent のパブリッシング水準の向上に貢献する。

title: Tencent Cloud Senior Industry Product Operations Manager — Risk Control & Anti-Fraud (Indonesia)
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a (Senior) Industry Product Operations Manager with solid experience in risk control, anti-fraud, business security, and financial risk management, as well as strong commercialisation capabilities and bilingual communication skills in native language and English.
This role will be responsible for supporting the commercialisation and solution delivery of Tencent Cloud Risk Control Solution, TCRS, in overseas markets. The position will serve as a critical bridge between product, sales, solution, delivery, and client teams.

The successful candidate will be expected to deeply understand overseas clients’ risk challenges across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing campaigns, transactions, payments, credit application, account security, and user lifecycle management. The candidate will translate Tencent Cloud’s capabilities in business security, risk identification, anti-fraud, device risk, account security, payment risk control, and financial risk management into industry solutions that are sellable, deliverable, and scalable.
This role requires not only strong technical understanding, but also strong business acumen, client communication skills, and solution packaging capabilities. The candidate will support overseas sales teams throughout the full sales cycle, including requirement discovery, solution design, client presentation, product demonstration, POC execution, pricing support, and commercial conversion.

1. Drive Overseas Commercialisation of TCRS

• Lead the solution design and commercial landing of Tencent Cloud TCRS products in overseas markets, covering risk control, anti-fraud, and financial risk management.

• Develop industry-specific solutions for clients in fintech, digital banking, consumer finance, payments, e-commerce, gaming, content platforms, and social networking.

• Translate TCRS capabilities, including device risk, account security, transaction risk control, payment risk control, credit risk control, rule engines, and model scoring, into clear business value that clients can understand.

2. Support the End-to-End Overseas Sales Process

• Support sales, business development, and channel teams in client requirement discovery, solution design, technical engagement, product demonstration, POC execution, and pricing support.

• Independently conduct product introductions, solution walkthroughs, technical Q&A, and value presentations to clients in both native language and English.

• Help identify clients’ real pain points, purchasing motivations, and decision-making processes, and drive opportunities from the requirement stage to POC, quotation, and contract signing.

3. Design Anti-Fraud and Business Security Solutions

• Analyse client risk issues and design solutions across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing, transactions, payments, and account security.

• Cover typical risk cases including fake registration, account theft, marketing abuse, promotion abuse, card-not-present fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, and organised fraud.

• Design localised risk control solutions by combining capabilities such as device risk, behavioural risk, IP risk, account risk, relationship networks, rules, and machine learning models.

4. Support Financial Risk Management Solutions

• Design pre-loan, in-loan, and post-loan risk management solutions for financial clients, including digital banks, consumer finance companies, cash loan providers, BNPL platforms, payment institutions, and e-wallets.

• Cover key scenarios such as identity verification, application fraud detection, credit assessment, credit approval, limit management, transaction monitoring, post-loan early warning, and collection segmentation.

• Support financial clients in POC test design, performance evaluation, strategy optimisation, and business value assessment.

5. Drive Product Requirement Closure

• Collect overseas client requirements related to anti-fraud, payment risk control, credit risk management, and compliance risk management, and translate them into product requirements and implementation roadmaps.

• Work closely with product, R&D, algorithm, data, delivery, and sales teams to convert client requirements into product capabilities.

• Consolidate project experience from key accounts and develop standardised industry solutions, case studies, POC templates, and sales enablement tools.

6. Sales Enablement and Market Insights

• Deliver product training, industry training, case study training, and competitor training to sales, business development, channel, and partner teams.

• Produce materials such as product introductions, industry solution decks, client case studies, FAQs, competitor analysis, and deployment documentation.

• Track overseas trends in risk control, anti-fraud, fintech, and compliance, and provide input to support the overseas GTM strategy of TCRS.

Who We Look For

• Bachelor’s degree or above;

• Minimum 5 years of experience in internet risk control, anti-fraud, business security, fintech risk management, payment risk control, credit risk management, or related fields.

• Excellent bilingual communication skills in native language and English, with the ability to conduct client communication, solution presentations, business discussions, document drafting, and cross-border team collaboration in English. Madarin Speaking skill is a Plus.

• Strong client-facing communication skills and business understanding, with the ability to independently conduct requirement discovery, solution articulation, and value presentation.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities, with the ability to coordinate product, R&D, algorithm, delivery, sales, and partner resources to drive complex projects to successful delivery.
